_note: Six-step learning plan for any recommended skill. SkillPath recommends WHAT to learn and WHERE (free, external resources); it does not host lesson content. Tokens: {skill} = skill name, {query} = URL-encoded skill name, {how_to_show} = the measurable task that shows the skill, {esco_url} = ESCO page if available. Add skill-specific plans under 'skills' keyed by skill slug (six entries each).

default.title: What is {skill}?
default.description: Read what this skill means and what you will be able to show at the end (below). Takes about 5 minutes.

default.title: Watch a short introduction
default.description: Find a short introductory video on {skill} (under 10 minutes) and write down two things you learnt. Video uses mobile data, so Wi-Fi is best.

default.title: Start a free course
default.description: Choose a free or free-to-audit course on {skill} and complete its first short lesson.

default.title: Practise with a tutorial
default.description: Follow a beginner tutorial on {skill} and do each step yourself rather than only watching.

default.title: Go a step deeper
default.description: Pick one more lesson on {skill} from a different provider to see it explained another way.

default.title: Show what you can do
default.description: Prove the skill: {how_to_show} Then add it to your CV with one line describing what you did, and look for opportunities that ask for it. SAYouth.mobi is zero-rated (no data cost) on South African networks.
